subject.title: [Bug]: In msteams channel messages, OpenClaw can't access inbound attachments

question: Should Microsoft Teams non-personal Graph media fallback be enabled automatically when no media is extracted, or stay default-off behind a new channels.msteams.graphMediaFallback option?
rationale: Current main avoids noisy Graph lookups by requiring extracted attachment ids, but Teams can omit those ids for real uploaded files; the default affects existing deployments through Graph call volume, permissions expectations, diagnostics, and message-delivery behavior.

options.title: Default-off opt-in fallback
options.body: Adopt the config-gated shape so existing installs keep the current mention-only protection unless operators explicitly opt into extra Graph message reads.

options.title: Automatic non-personal fallback
options.body: Relax the gate for all non-personal HTML activities with no media so attachments work without new config, accepting extra Graph reads and possible mention-only noise.

options.title: Combine the fix candidates
options.body: Ask one branch to cover both the channel aadGroupId/reply URL fixes and the group-chat fallback gate so the compatibility story lands once.

recommendation.title: Default-off opt-in fallback
recommendation.body: Adopt the config-gated shape so existing installs keep the current mention-only protection unless operators explicitly opt into extra Graph message reads.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest recent merged ownership signal across msteams inbound-media and channel delivery while the remaining choice is a compatibility/product default decision.
